questions.question: Explain why a square has 4 lines of symmetry but a rectangle has only 2.
questions.expected_answer: A square folds onto itself across the middle both ways and along both diagonals, because all its sides are equal. A rectangle folds onto itself only across the middle both ways; folding along a diagonal does not match the halves.

questions.question: 40 learners chose swings 12, slides 8, picnic 5 and soccer 15. Check the total and say how many more chose soccer than picnic.
questions.expected_answer: 12 plus 8 plus 5 plus 15 is 40, which matches the 40 learners asked. Soccer beat picnic by 15 minus 5, which is 10.

questions.question: A vegetable garden is a rectangle 8 m long and 5 m wide. Find its perimeter and explain the difference between perimeter and area.
questions.expected_answer: The perimeter is 8 plus 5 plus 8 plus 5, which is 26 m. Perimeter is the distance around the edge, measured in metres, while area is the flat surface inside, measured in squares.
